asked:
This job will iterate through every file in your database's file storage, extracting any it does not expect to be there. This is particularly useful for 're-syncing' your file storage to what it should be after, say, marrying an older/newer database with a newer/older file storage.

You can choose to move the orphans in your file directories somewhere or delete them. Orphan thumbnails will be put in a subdirectory, in case you wish to perform reverse lookups.

Access to files and thumbnails will be slightly limited while this runs, and it may take some time.
